metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-os[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Spotify episodes become first-class podcast references[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every Spotify episode link given to `bob ref create`, capture, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Keep becomes one deduplicated `podcasts` reference. Its PDF is an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]episode dossier: cover, show, date, duration, clickable chapters, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]full show notes, and a highlightable transcript when the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]publisher's own feed proves the match. Every other Spotify link is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]refused, or is kept as an ordinary item, with a hint that says what[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]to do instead. No Spotify link reaches the article engine again.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]spotify_episode_refs.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/spotify_episode_refs.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-os[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-os/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]General capture fixes the audit exposed[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]clean_capture[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]clean_capture: reject base62 ids as URL stems, persist the write-once [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]source store on the ingest path, and print the recorded URL (not the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-redirect URL) in web PDF mastheads.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Spotify link identity, canonical dedupe, and routing guards[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]spotify_identity[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]spotify_identity: add the spotify.rs link grammar with canonical [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]case-preserving identity and ?t= capture, resolve short links, gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture/Keep admission, and refuse non-episodes, -L, -H, and collections[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with teaching hints.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Episode metadata ladder and show-notes segmentation[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]episode_metadata[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spotify_identity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]episode_metadata: fetch and parse browserless episode metadata (page [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state, JSON-LD/meta, embed, oEmbed), segment show notes into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notes/chapters/sponsor blocks, and download cover art, all [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fixture-tested.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adapter render op and the episode dossier template[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]dossier_render[dim] · [dim][/dim]after clean_capture[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]dossier_render: add the offline adapter `render` op and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]podcast-episode dossier layout, CSS, and source view, plus the Rust [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]client method and fake-adapter support.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The podcast route in bob ref create[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]episode_route[dim] · [dim][/dim]after episode_metadata, dossier_render[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]episode_route: wire Spotify episodes into create (new, dry run, reread, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overwrite) as podcasts refs with title stems, honest reports, the source[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store, help, and docs, then smoke-test live.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture jobs and Keep file episodes through the same route[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]episode_ingest[dim] · [dim][/dim]after episode_route[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]episode_ingest: route Spotify episodes in ingest_url through the shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dossier builder, carry ?t= from the original URL, turn %l into a hint, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and type every failure.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publisher feed discovery and proven item match[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]feed_match[dim] · [dim][/dim]after episode_metadata[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]feed_match: find the show's public RSS feed through iTunes Search, parse[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it safely with a capped fetch, and accept only a unique item agreeing on[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]two of three signals.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publisher transcript parsing and paragraphing[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]transcript_text[dim] · [dim][/dim]after episode_metadata[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]transcript_text: parse JSON/VTT/SRT/HTML/text transcripts into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sanity-checked, speaker-labelled paragraphs with honest role inference.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Feed enrichment in the dossier and both routes[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]transcript_dossier[dim] · [dim][/dim]after episode_ingest, feed_match, transcript_text[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]transcript_dossier: attach proven feed notes, chapters, and transcripts [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to create and ingest captures under a time budget, render the transcript[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pages, add the enrich knob, and report each step-down once.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Podcast surfaces across repos and the legacy refs[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]rollout[dim] · [dim][/dim]after transcript_dossier[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rollout: give podcasts refs their own kind in Bob Mac Capture, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reading board, and refs.base, upgrade the two legacy refs per decision, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and author the optional decision record.[/#D7D7AF]
